text_block_list.text: Her camping stories sounded so fun that I came out to the mountains to try it myself, but—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: So you got completely lost, huh? Good thing I happened to be passing by then.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it fine to be interested?
Camping really is a lot of fun, after all."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading back to the campsite for a bit.
Wanna come along, Trainer?
Without a second thought, I nodded and decided to accompany Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Alright, arrived.
choice_data_list: Um... what about the camping gear?

text_block_list.text: At our destination, there was no tent pitched, nor any camping stove set up. Mr. C.B. only had a single backpack for luggage, but...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I'm gonna prepare everything now!
Food, camping gear—I forage and craft it all myself.
It's super fun!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Caretaker!
I'll help you prune the dead branches,
so can I keep the scraps to use as camping supplies?

text_block_list.name: Mountain Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Ah, go right ahead.
Feel free to use as many of the collected branches as you like.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer, grab some pruning shears too.
Let's go get materials for the chairs and bonfire.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yep, we got a good branch.
Now, we take this and—
Taking a thick cloth from her backpack, Mr. C.B. threaded it through some propped-up dead branches, fashioning a makeshift chair.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, looking good, looking good.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"If we're eating, we definitely gotta enjoy seasonal flavors, right~?
This time of year, that'd be—"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Oh, found some tasty-looking wild vegetables!
choice_data_list: I wonder if those leaves over there are edible too?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you can't eat that one.
The one by your feet is fine, though.
It has a pretty distinct flavor.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Wah, there's a huge one over there!
Let's make that our main meal today!
choice_data_list: Huh? But I don't have a fishing rod...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Grab it with your bare hands! Come on, come on,
if you let it get away, your dinner's gonna be wild greens~"

I'd rather pass on that. If it's come to this, it seems there's no choice but to catch one no matter what...!
Focusing every nerve, aiming for the fish—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what kind of battle cry is that?!
And you actually caught it, too!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations.
A job well done, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“—Alright, time to get cookin'!
I've got the fire going, so skewer what
we gathered onto branches.”

After finishing the prep work, we sat on folding chairs
and quietly watched the fish and wild vegetables
slowly roast over the fire together.

I was utterly exhausted from moving all over
the mountains, but it wasn't a bad kind of tiredness.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Looks like it's done baking. Trainer, you should have some too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Right?
Guess I'll dig in too~

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Mmm, now this is the bounty of nature! Nothing beats freshly picked and freshly grilled!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...I'm getting sleepy now that my belly's full.
*yawn*... Nighty-night for a bit~
Following her lead, I also sit down on a chair and close my eyes.

Leaving the bustling city behind for self-sufficiency in the quiet mountains—
Losing track of time living like this,
it felt as if I had become part of nature myself.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was a good sleep!
Shall we head back now?
choice_data_list: I don't wanna go home just yet...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, even though you were about to get stranded?
choice_data_list: Because thanks to you, I got to enjoy the mountains with C.B.

text_block_list.text:
"If you'd like, again..." I start to say, but close my mouth.
It felt wrong to bind her with a promise.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...
I come here from time to time.
So—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: If we ever meet, treat me well then.

"Carried along by the whims of the wind,
how wonderful it would be to have another encounter like this—
With faint hope in my heart, I began the journey home."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then do you want to keep living in the mountains like this?
The mountains get pretty dangerous at night, you know.
And whenever the weather turns rough—

Mr. C.B. flashes a mischievous grin,
prompting a hurried shake of the head in response.
choice_data_list: I'm coming back! Because I want to dream beside you!
I'm coming back! Because I want to dream beside you!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Is that so?
Then I'll leave the rest to you."

Whistling a delightfully lighthearted tune,
Mr. C.B. strolled off on a whim.
With that dreamlike time at an end, I hurriedly chased after her retreating figure—ready to dream of her once more.
